name: Stagent
description: State machine workflow orchestrator that drives Claude Code through long tasks it would otherwise drop. Prevents task abandonment by enforcing multi-step completion with self-approval guards and TDD validation.
community_quotes: Claude Code is great at starting long tasks — bad at finishing. It self-approves, patches symptoms, fakes TDD, stops at 'code written.'

name: RoBrain
description: Open-source shared AI memory system that captures team decisions and rejected alternatives to prevent agents from repeating mistakes. Provides persistent knowledge across AI agent interactions.

name: Comie.dev
description: Production context layer for AI coding agents that connects them to production infrastructure including logs, databases, and error tracking for real-world debugging capabilities.

name: Agent FM for Claude Code & Codex
description: File manager and agent interface for Claude Code and Codex that enhances file navigation and manipulation capabilities within AI coding workflows.

name: Raindrop Workshop
description: Open-source, free, local debugger specifically designed for AI agents. Enables developers to inspect and debug AI agent behavior locally without cloud dependencies.

name: Asteroid
description: Rapid AI agent builder that creates Browser, Linux, and Windows AI agents in seconds. Lowers barrier to building cross-platform autonomous AI systems.

name: Open Computer Use
description: Open-source framework for computer-use AI agents that enables autonomous interaction with desktop interfaces and applications at the system level.

name: Open Browser Use
description: Open-source browser automation agent framework for building AI agents that can navigate and interact with web pages autonomously.

name: Openclaw OS
description: Development platform that turns one-off AI chat interactions into persistent, reusable applications. Bridges the gap between conversational AI and deployable software.

name: Claudy
description: Multi-session, multi-account management interface for Claude Code. Provides a proper workspace environment for Claude Code with enhanced session handling and account switching.

name: Latitude for Claude Code
description: Observability and token usage tracking tool for Claude Code. Shows where Claude Code burns tokens to help developers hit API limits less frequently and optimize costs.

name: Warp
description: Open-source agentic development environment built with community collaboration. Represents a new approach to IDEs with AI-first architecture and community-driven development.

name: Graphbit PRFlow
description: AI-powered code reviewer for pull requests that catches issues that traditional reviewers miss. Integrates into GitHub workflows to automate code review quality assurance.

name: Weavable
description: Persistent work context infrastructure that gives every AI agent access to shared project memory and context. Addresses the context gap in multi-agent AI development workflows.

name: display.dev
description: Deployment platform that publishes AI agent-generated HTML behind company authentication. Enables secure sharing and hosting of agent-created web content with enterprise access controls.
